evals.prompt: Update this conductor workspace to the latest version. The workflow and styleguides were created with an earlier conductor release.
evals.expected_output: Detects older workflow and missing ADR / agent links in index, preserves existing custom rules in workflow.md, merges new standard sections, verifies integrity with conductor verify, and stages changes.
expectations: Updated workflow.md contains TDD Red-Green-Refactor phase definitions
Updated workflow.md contains Git Notes summary attachment steps
Updated index.md maintains relative path integrity to core documents
Summary output reports updated components and verification state

evals.prompt: My conductor/workflow.md has custom test coverage requirements of 95% and custom commit message formats. Can you update the conductor setup to support ADRs and subagents without losing my custom settings?
evals.expected_output: Performs three-way merge on workflow.md keeping the 95% coverage setting and commit format while adding ADR and subagent sections, updating index.md to link adrs, and passing conductor verify.
expectations: Updated workflow.md preserves custom 95% code coverage threshold
Updated workflow.md preserves custom commit message format myapp(scope): message
Updated workflow.md incorporates Subagents and Git Notes sections
Index handshake preserves existing links without breaking syntax

evals.prompt: Check if my conductor files are out of date and upgrade anything needed.
evals.expected_output: Audits workspace, identifies missing sections, presents migration choices to user, executes update, and verifies with bun run conductor verify.
expectations: Pre-update audit detects missing or outdated sections
Updated workflow.md contains operational standards and review checkpoints
Integrity verification passes or confirms zero broken relative links in index.md
